name: José Miguel Montoya Morales
bio: José Miguel's research focuses on human capital investment, with particular interest in how educational trajectories—beyond years of schooling—shape labor market opportunities. His broader interests span poverty and inequality, public policy, behavioral science, and the role of institutions in shaping social outcomes. He is the founder of the Student Research Club (CIA UP) and a co-author of applied research on corporate sustainability with Roland Berger.
